_meta_pipeline_notes.purpose: Scoot(34) player card figure generation — see arch/player-cards.md v1.1 in this repo
_meta_pipeline_notes.how_to_run: Not runnable as-is: node 2 (checkpoint), node 7 (controlnet union model), node 12+13 (ipadapter model + style reference image) all need real files present in ComfyUI/models/*. See README.md in this folder for exact files to download onto the GPU box.
_meta_pipeline_notes.per_player_inputs: Swap node 1's 'image' (the rembg cutout, see prep_cutout.py) and both SaveImage filename_prefix values (nodes 19, 21) per player. Everything else — checkpoint, controlnet weights, ipadapter, style reference, seed, prompt skeleton — stays FIXED across all players. That fixedness is the whole point: 34 cards need to read as one set.
_meta_pipeline_notes.post_processing: ComfyUI's SaveImage output is NOT the final deliverable. Run finalize_card.py on it afterward — that script re-mattes the alpha with rembg (same technique validated against the Nick video frames), hard-thresholds it, verifies true RGBA, and writes the actual {serial}_figure.png / {serial}_jersey_mask.png named per spec. See the alpha-channel warning in arch/player-cards.md — a prior batch shipped RGB-flattened files with a silently destroyed alpha channel.
_meta_pipeline_notes.seed: Change SEED_PLACEHOLDER in node 16 to a real fixed integer before the first real run, then never touch it again for this edition.
_meta_pipeline_notes.geometry_note: 1400x2000 output size matches the figure.png spec, NOT card geometry — card placement is build_cards.py's job and geometry isn't locked yet.

1._note: rembg cutout of the player, see prep_cutout.py. Swap per player.

2._note: See README.md for recommended checkpoint. Fixed across all players.

inputs.text: PROMPT_SKELETON_PLACEHOLDER — see README.md for the draft prompt. Fixed skeleton, do not vary per player.

7._note: Single Union ControlNet handles both lineart and openpose — see README.md. If it underperforms, swap nodes 7-9 for two separate dedicated ControlNetLoaders (one lineart, one openpose) instead.

10._note: Lineart conditioning pass. Fixed weight across all players — do not tune per player, that's what breaks set consistency.

11._note: Openpose conditioning pass, chained after lineart. Fixed weight.

13._note: ONE fixed style reference image, reused for every player. This is the single most important consistency lever in the whole graph — do not swap this per player.

15._note: SDXL-native resolution close to the 0.700 front aspect. Upscaled to the real 1400x2000 deliverable size in node 18.

16._note: seed is FIXED for the whole edition — this is what makes 34 generations read as one set instead of 34 separate rolls. Only nodes 1 (cutout) and 5/6 (their derived conditioning) vary per player.

22._note: IPAdapter FaceID branch -- 3 attempts (preset swap, weight 1.0, weight 1.8) never produced a decernable likeness; higher weight degraded overall image quality instead of helping. Left in place but UNREFERENCED (node 16 now sources from node 27/PuLID instead) for comparison -- ComfyUI skips nodes not in the output dependency chain, so this costs nothing at runtime.

23._note: Unreferenced, same as node 22 -- see that note.

27._note: PuLID identity branch, added 2026-08-18 after FaceID (nodes 22/23, now unreferenced) failed to produce a decernable likeness in 3 attempts. Conditioned on node 1 (subject's own cutout), chained after the style branch (node 14), feeds KSampler directly. method="fidelity" prioritizes identity resemblance over letting the checkpoint's style dominate -- the primary goal right now is a recognizable face; style can be re-balanced once likeness is achieved.

19._note: Raw generation output. NOT the deliverable — run finalize_card.py on this afterward for the real alpha-clean {serial}_figure.png.

20._note: Isolates jersey pixels only. If a player's signature pose has the jersey mostly hidden (e.g. back turned), check this mask by hand — segformer was trained on real photos, not comic illustrations, so accuracy on generated art needs spot-checking.
